name: TPC Craig Ranch
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (22200); its pars match OpenStreetMap's hole tags (par 72); its handicaps differ from OSM's and are used. Its six named tees are kept (the I-IV rows look like combinations). Its tee table rates other lengths; ratings are given only where a tee's length is close: Tpc = PGA Tour (7414), Craig Ranch = Craig Ranch (6688), West = Forward (5145). Men's ratings. The club's own card (tpc.com) couldn't be read from here.
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course: nothing here; trim_far.py drops the range, practice greens and short-game area east of #1 and #2.
_comment_shift: OSM outlines sit this many metres off the Esri imagery; every point is moved by it (fitted to the bunkers on sand; the greens agree).
